plot.title: Average Speed by Time of Day
plot.description: Average taxi speed is plotted in 30-minute bins with the two low-speed windows highlighted.

insight_list.question: When does average taxi speed reach local minima during the day?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare the two low-speed windows before interpreting their spatial correlates.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d = df.copy()
d['start_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d['timestamp'])
d['speed_kmh'] = d['distance_km'] / d['duration_seconds'].replace(0, pd.NA) * 3600
d['time_bin'] = d['start_time'].dt.floor('30min')
speed = d.groupby('time_bin')['speed_kmh'].mean()
speed.plot(figsize=(12,5), marker='o')
plt.title('Average taxi speed by time of day')
plt.xlabel('Time')
plt.ylabel('Average speed (km/h)')
plt.show()

insight_list.insight: During the 06:30–09:30 low-speed period, most taxis in the selected area pass through the same road junction, which is a possible spatial correlate of the low observed speed.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = pd.read_csv('trajstory_examples/insight/Porto_taxi/01_overall_characterization/trajectory_points.csv')
t['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(t['timestamp'])
t = t[(t['timestamp'].dt.hour + t['timestamp'].dt.minute / 60 >= 6.5) & (t['timestamp'].dt.hour + t['timestamp'].dt.minute / 60 < 9.5)]
plt.figure(figsize=(9,6))
for _, q in t.groupby('trajectory_id'):
 plt.plot(q['lon'], q['lat'], alpha=.35)
plt.scatter([-8.611], [41.149], c='red', s=80, label='Common junction')
plt.xlabel('Longitude'); plt.ylabel('Latitude'); plt.title('Morning trajectories and common junction')
plt.legend(); plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d = df.copy(); t = pd.to_datetime(d['timestamp']); h = t.dt.hour + t.dt.minute / 60
d = d[(h >= 15.5) & (h < 19)]
d['station'] = d['origin_stand'].map({'15':'Station A','16':'Station B'}).fillna('Other origins')
d['station'].value_counts().reindex(['Station A','Station B','Other origins']).plot(kind='pie',autopct='%1.0f%%',ylabel='')
plt.title('Afternoon trip-origin share'); plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d = df.copy()
t = pd.to_datetime(d['timestamp'])
h = t.dt.hour + t.dt.minute / 60
d = d[(h < 6.5) | ((h >= 9.5) & (h < 15.5)) | (h >= 19)]
d['CALL_TYPE'] = d['call_type']
d['CALL_TYPE'].value_counts().reindex(['A','B','C'], fill_value=0).plot(kind='bar')
plt.title('CALL_TYPE distribution outside the two low-speed periods')
plt.xlabel('CALL_TYPE'); plt.ylabel('Trip count'); plt.show()

insights: Average taxi speed reaches local minima during 06:30–09:30 and 15:30–19:00.
During the 06:30–09:30 low-speed period, most taxis in the selected area pass through the same road junction, which is a possible spatial correlate of the low observed speed.
During the 15:30-19:00 low-speed period, most trips start at the two taxi-stand locations A and B.
Outside the 06:30–09:30 and 15:30–19:00 periods, the three CALL_TYPE categories are approximately balanced.
summary: Taxi driving in the selected Porto area shows two low-speed periods with different spatial contexts: a recurring morning junction and a concentration of afternoon trip origins at two taxi stands. Outside these periods, pickup channels are approximately balanced.
